AccentColor.description: The Radix palette — every name `ThemeProps['accentColor']` accepts, spelled out (rather than derived from Radix's type) so the MCP's generated JSON Schema lists them; `ACCENT_COLORS` below must stay assignable to Radix's.

ActionSize.description: Row-action button steps of both tables (engine `DataTableActionSize`); `''` = the engine default.

logo.description: Logo image URL — or the `data:` URL of an uploaded image — shown before the title (wins over `icon`).

logoSize.description: CSS height of the logo (empty = the library's `1.5rem`).

variant.description: Neutral panel surface, painted in the theme accent, or a custom colour / gradient.

background.description: The custom bar's colour (any CSS colour).

gradient.description: The custom bar's gradient (wins over `background` while enabled): `from` → `to` at `angle` degrees.

foreground.description: Text / icon colour on the custom bar; empty = picked from the paint's luminance.

padding.description: CSS padding of the bar (empty = the library's `0 0.75rem`).

sidebarToggle.description: `IconData` keys of the desktop collapse button (empty = library chevrons).

AppBarSettings.description: The exported app's top bar (the library `AppBarConfig`); empty strings mean unset.

source.description: `binding`: the rows are `items` (a page load / the repeater item); `endpoint`: the line fetches `read` itself.

recordPath.description: Dot path from the response to the request record (engine `api.paths`).

stepsPath.description: Dot path from the record to the step rows (engine `stepsPath`); empty = the record is the list.

requesterNamePath.description: Endpoint mode: paths into the fetched record (fallbacks, like the keys).

ApprovalLineConfig.description: Editable config for an approval line (see the grilled design). Maps onto the engine `ApprovalLineElement`: the raw step rows come from `items` (a page load or the enclosing repeater's item), read through `keys` — each a list of fallback paths, typed one per line — labelled by `roleRules`, and mapped by `statuses` (the defaults are the engine's; exported only when changed). The requester is a fixed first step with its own bindings.

ApprovalLineKeyConfig.description: One key of an approval line's row mapping: paths tried in order (see the engine `ApprovalKeyPath`).

ApprovalStatusConfig.description: One row of the status map: a backend code, its step state and its tooltip label.

ArrayOf.description: What an `array` field holds: a primitive, or an object (nested fields).

devValues.description: Dev default values per setting, seeded into a project's Env rows on pick.

paths.description: Dot path to the profile record inside the response (`data`).

emailParam.description: The `:param` / query key that receives the signed-in email.

userMenu.description: Paths into the profile record (fallback lists; a `{{a}} {{b}}` template is allowed).

srcBinding.description: Inside a repeater: image URL from this item field (`src` = fallback).

fallbackBinding.description: Inside a repeater: initials from this item field (`fallback` = fallback).

AvatarConfig.description: Editable config for an avatar. Maps onto the library's `Avatar` / engine `AvatarElement` (`name` is the element's optional binding key). `src` empty shows the `fallback` text (or the first letter of `alt`); `size` sticks to the named steps — the numeric form stays hand-editable in the exported JSON.

gradient.description: `kind: gradient` — both stops needed, at `angle` degrees.

image.description: `kind: image` — a URL or a `data:` URL (uploaded, ≤ 300 KB), drawn `cover`.

BackdropConfig.description: The glass backdrop, structured (the app bar's paint is the precedent). Lowered to the engine's single CSS `background` string on export — only while the surface is glass and `kind` is not `default`.

BackdropKind.description: What the glass backdrop is: the engine's accent gradient, one colour, a gradient, or an image.

BuiltinButtonActionKey.description: The engine `ButtonAction`s studio offers in ordered lists. `ConfirmBox` is modelled as the panel's mode (not a list entry — the engine only honors it as `actions[0]`, and everything after it is dead), and `OpenModal` / `SubmitFormToDeleteAPI` are silent no-ops in the engine's `Button` switch, so they aren't offered (see the grilled design).

ButtonActionKey.description:
A built-in engine action, or a project custom action by its declaration
**id** (`"fn:action-…"`, see `Workspace/customActions.ts`) — resolved to the engine's `"fn:<name>"` at export.

variant.description: Exported only off the engine default (`contained`).

color.description: A Radix colour name (`red`, `iris`, …) for this button; `''` / absent = the theme (its button colour, else the accent). Optional, so configs saved before it existed need no migration. Exported only when set.

ButtonConfig.description: Editable config for a button's visual slice: `label`, its `variant` + an optional `icon` key into the library's `IconData` glyph map (`''` = no icon). Modal/popover trigger buttons carry exactly this (their behavior is owned by the host); standalone button items extend it with behavior via `ButtonItemConfig`. Color comes from the theme.

mode.description: `direct` runs `actions` on click; `confirm` opens a ConfirmBox and runs `confirmTrue`/`confirmFalse` (exports `actions: ["ConfirmBox"]`).

confirmTrue.description: Ordered actions run when the ConfirmBox is accepted / dismissed.

modalItemId.description: Grid-item id of the modal `CloseModal` targets (`''` = none); exports as the modal's current `ModalConfig.id`.

reloadTableItemId.description: Grid-item id of the (editable) data table to reload after a submit (`''` = none); exports as the table's current `name`.

endpointId.description: API page endpoint the submit actions call, by `EndpointDef.id` (`null` = unwired — the export omits `api`).

snackbarErrorException.description: Exports `snackbarError: "$exception"` — the only form the engine reads (it shows the thrown API error's message).

navigate.description: Target of the `Navigate` action (engine `ButtonElement.navigate`); absent until the action is added.

variant.description: Exported only off the engine default (`contained`).

color.description: A Radix colour name (`red`, `iris`, …) for this button; `''` / absent = the theme (its button colour, else the accent). Optional, so configs saved before it existed need no migration. Exported only when set.

ButtonItemConfig.description: Full editable config for a *standalone* button item — the visual slice plus the engine `ButtonElement` behavior (see the grilled design). References are stored by stable id (grid-item id / `EndpointDef.id`) and resolved to current names at export, so renames can't strand the button.

ButtonVariant.description: A button's visual weight. Mirrors the library's `ButtonVariant`.

mode.description: `direct` runs `actions` on click; `confirm` opens a ConfirmBox and runs `confirmTrue`/`confirmFalse` (exports `actions: ["ConfirmBox"]`).

confirmTrue.description: Ordered actions run when the ConfirmBox is accepted / dismissed.

modalItemId.description: Grid-item id of the modal `CloseModal` targets (`''` = none); exports as the modal's current `ModalConfig.id`.

reloadTableItemId.description: Grid-item id of the (editable) data table to reload after a submit (`''` = none); exports as the table's current `name`.

endpointId.description: API page endpoint the submit actions call, by `EndpointDef.id` (`null` = unwired — the export omits `api`).

snackbarErrorException.description: Exports `snackbarError: "$exception"` — the only form the engine reads (it shows the thrown API error's message).

navigate.description: Target of the `Navigate` action (engine `ButtonElement.navigate`); absent until the action is added.

variant.description: Exported only off the engine default (`contained`).

color.description: A Radix colour name (`red`, `iris`, …) for this button; `''` / absent = the theme (its button colour, else the accent). Optional, so configs saved before it existed need no migration. Exported only when set.

CardActionConfig.description: One footer button (or the header action). A `ButtonItemConfig` so the full button editor could take it over later; the card panel edits its label / icon / variant and a `Navigate` target (`actions` is `['Navigate']` while a target is set, else `[]`). `id` keys the sortable list.

CardConfig.description: Editable config for a card. Maps onto the engine `CardElement` minus the two nested containers — `content` is child canvas 0 and the expandable section child canvas 1 (exported only while `collapseEnabled`).

CardHeaderConfig.description: The card's header slot (MUI `CardHeader`): title / subheader (static or bound to the enclosing repeater item), an optional avatar and an optional action button at the end (icon-only by default — MUI's ⋮).

CellLines.description: Line-clamp choices for a data table cell / column: `0` = wrap freely.

defaultChecked.description: Single-mode initial checked state (emitted as the element's `checked`).

options.description: Group-mode options. Carried in single mode too (so a mode switch is lossless).

CheckboxConfig.description: Editable config for a checkbox component. The checkbox is dual-natured, so `mode` discriminates a single boolean toggle from a multi-option group (mirroring how `SelectFieldConfig.mode` forks static/source). Both halves are always carried so switching modes loses nothing: `defaultChecked` drives the single toggle's initial state, `options`/`orientation` drive the group. Maps onto the library's `CheckboxBase` / engine `CheckboxElement`; `dataType` is derived on export (single→`boolean`, group→`any`), not edited here.

CheckboxOption.description: A single option in a checkbox group. Maps onto the library `CheckboxProps` option shape (`value`/`label`/`disabled`) minus `helperText` — per-option sub-labels are out of studio's scope. Carried even in `single` mode so toggling to `group` doesn't start empty.

ContainerConfig.description: A plain nested container: the engine `Container.surface` flags — a themed panel background and / or a border.

CustomComponentConfig.description: Editable config for a custom component (see the grilled design). Maps onto the engine `CustomComponentElement`: `componentId` is the project declaration (`Workspace/customComponents.ts`) resolved to its `name` at export, `props` the authored text per declared prop key (parsed to the prop's kind at export), `binding` the one bound `value`.

key.description: The key on the engine `props` object: a JS identifier.

label.description: Field label in the inspector (the key when empty).

defaultValue.description: Pre-fills the inspector field; omitted from the export when unchanged.

CustomPropKind.description:
Custom components (see the grilled design in the library's `core/components.tsx`): React components the developer codes in the app and hands to `<ComponentsProvider components={{ Chart, … }}>`, which a `custom` Bin places by name (`element.component`). The studio only knows the *declarations*: a project declares them once (the Env page's "Custom components" section) — a name plus the props the component accepts, each with a kind so the inspector can draw a typed field — items pick one, the export writes a typed `components.tsx` stub for every declared name, and the Live Preview mounts a placeholder stub per name that shows the resolved value.

Item configs store the declaration's stable **id**, so a rename propagates and a deleted declaration shows as dangling; the export resolves it to the name, or `MISSING_COMPONENT` when it is gone — loud in the config, a placeholder in the engine (same pattern as `MISSING_ACTION`).

DataCondition.description: Show an item only while a page load is in a state, or while one of its fields compares to a value (see the grilled page-data design) — exported as a `source: "state"` engine condition. `set` / `unset` compare against `undefined`; the other operators against `value` (JSON-parsed when it spells a number / boolean / null, else the text).

id.description: Studio-only stable card identity; never exported.

useDateFormat.description: dayjs format tokens; `''` = no date formatting.

pin.description: Engine `ColumnDef.pin` — sticky while the table scrolls sideways; `''` = not pinned.

html.description: Engine `ColumnDef.html` — the cell's HTML template (`{{field}}` placeholders); `''` = plain value.

sortField.description: Engine `ColumnDef.sortField` — the field `api.sort` sends; `''` = the accessor.

lines.description: Engine `ColumnDef.lines` — this column's line clamp (`0` = none); `''` = the table's `cellLines`.

rowHeader.description: Engine `ColumnDef.rowHeader` — the row's label column (`<th scope="row">`, pinned left); one per table.

mergeRows.description: Engine `ColumnDef.mergeRows` — consecutive equal values share one cell.

mergeColumns.description: Engine `ColumnDef.mergeColumns` — adjacent equal values (both flagged) share one cell.

group.description: Engine `ColumnDef.group` — adjacent columns with the same label share a group header; `''` = none.

DataTableColumnConfig.description: One column of a data table. Maps 1:1 onto the engine's `ColumnDef` (`accessor`/`header`/`enableSorting`/`enableColumnFilter`/`align`/`useDateFormat`) so the exported JSON is lossless. `useDateFormat` holds dayjs tokens and is `''` when the raw value should render untouched (dropped on export). `id` is a studio-only stable identity for the sortable column cards (dnd-kit keys) — every export path maps fields explicitly, so it never reaches engine JSON.

canSearchAllColumns.description: The header's "Search all columns" box (engine `canSearch`; exported only when off).

endpointId.description: The API page endpoint feeding the table, by `EndpointDef.id` (`null` = unwired — the export omits `api` and the consumer wires it). Resolved to the endpoint's current name at export; also what the Live Preview fetches.

rowsBinding.description: Rows from a page load instead of the endpoint (engine `items`, in-memory only): while set the export drops the read `api` — pagination, server sort and filters with it. `null` / absent = the endpoint.

apiPaths.description: Dot-path into the response to the row array (engine `api.paths`, e.g. `data`); `''` = the response is the array itself.

modalMaxWidth.description: Edit-modal sizing (engine `modalMaxWidth`/`modalMinWidth`/`modalMaxHeight`, CSS lengths; `''` = unset, dropped on export). The modal's *content* is the item's child canvas (drill-in), exported as `modalContainer` with `contextData` set to the table's binding name so the selected row prefills the form.

deleteEndpointId.description: The row-delete endpoint, by `EndpointDef.id` (`null` = unwired — the export omits `apiDeleteInfo` and `canDelete` stays as authored).

deleteParams.description: URL `:param` → row-field accessor (engine `apiDeleteInfo.params`, e.g. `{ id: "_id" }`). Keys derive from the endpoint URL's placeholders — the panel prunes on endpoint change and the export drops empty values.

deleteIsReload.description: Engine `apiDeleteInfo.isReload`: refetch the table after a delete.

deleteSnackbarErrorException.description: Exports `snackbarError: "$exception"` — the only form the engine reads (shows the API error message).

canAdd.description: Engine `canAdd` / `addButton`: an Add button in the table header opening the edit modal canvas over an empty row. Items in that canvas pick which mode shows them with `GridItemData.showWhen`. `addButton` is exported only off its defaults.

headerGap.description: Engine `headerGap` — spacing between title, Add button and search box; `''` = default (2).

canResizeColumns.description: Engine `canResizeColumns` — drag a header edge to resize; exported only when off.

actionSize.description: Engine `actionSize` — row-action button size (Edit / Delete …); `''` / absent = default (2). Optional, no migration.

cellLines.description: Engine `cellLines` — lines a plain cell shows before it is cut (a cut cell gets a tooltip); `0` = no clamp. Engine default 2.

filtersEnabled.description: Server-side custom filters (engine `filterContainer`): the filter form is the item's **second** child canvas (index 1), emitted while enabled and non-empty. `filterButton` / `filterDisplay` / `filterDefaults` export only off the engine defaults.

requestMapping.description: Engine `api.params` / `api.query` / `api.body` — one row per request key.

DataTableConfig.description: Editable config for a data table. Maps onto the engine's `DataTableElement` minus the pieces studio can't author yet: the `modalContainer`/sizing block is omitted on export (the consumer wires it). `canSearchAllColumns` is the engine's `canSearch` (emitted only when off). The `delete*` group authors the engine's `apiDeleteInfo` (`APIDelete`) and exports only when `canDelete` and an endpoint are set; the confirmBox True/False action arrays are baked export constants (see the grilled design), and the snackbar fields mirror `ButtonItemConfig`'s.

id.description: Studio-only stable card identity; never exported.

DataTableEditableColumnConfig.description: One column of an editable table. Maps onto the library's `DataTableEditableColumn` minus `size`, `defaultValue`, and the `validate` fn (not JSON-authorable) — see the grilled design. Every field is always carried so switching `editor` is lossless; the panel shows and the export emits only the fields relevant to the current editor: `options` for `select`, `min`/`max` for `number`, `minLength`/`maxLength`/`pattern`/`patternMessage` for `text`, and `requiredMessage` when `isRequired`. Numeric bounds are `''` when unset (mirroring `width`/`maxLength` elsewhere). `id` is a studio-only stable identity for the sortable column cards (dnd-kit keys); never exported.

canResizeColumns.description: Engine `canResizeColumns` — drag a header edge to resize; exported only when off.

actionSize.description: Engine `actionSize` — row-action button size (Edit / Delete …); `''` / absent = default (2). Optional, no migration.

readEndpointId.description: Optional API page endpoint refs for the CRUD calls, by `EndpointDef.id` (`null` = unwired). A set ref exports its endpoint's current name (and the Live Preview fetches `read` live); an unset one keeps the empty-name skeleton the consumer fills in. The action toggles above stay authoritative for which actions exist.

DataTablePaginationConfig.description: Server pagination authoring — the engine `DataTablePagination` with the studio's `''` / `'auto'` "unset" idioms. `placement: 'auto'` follows the engine's inference (the endpoint declares a body model ⇒ body, else query) and is dropped from the export; `searchKey: ''` = no server search; `totalPath` is a dot path split at export.

DataTableSortConfig.description: Engine `api.sort`. Exported only while `enabled` with both keys set; `placement: 'auto'` leaves the engine to infer it, `ascValue` / `descValue` export as `orderValues` only off `asc` / `desc` (numeric text → numbers), `defaultField` (`''` = none) as `default`.

DataTableThemeConfig.description: Per-role DataTable overrides — mirrors `ThemeComponents['dataTable']` with `''` = unset (follows accent / component default; edit = the button colour, delete = red). The two action-button roles are Radix buttons, so a pinned color is dark-safe; the rest route into the legacy light-only map when pinned.

displayFormat.description: dayjs tokens for date/datetime; one of the 3 range enums for `kind: 'range'`.

min.description: Earliest selectable value as an ISO string; `''` = unset.

max.description: Latest selectable value as an ISO string; `''` = unset.

weekStartsOn.description: First day of week (date/datetime only): 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday.

DateConfig.description: Editable config for the three date pickers, discriminated by `kind`: `'date'` → `DatePickerBase`/`DatePickerElement`, `'datetime'` → `DateTimePickerBase`/`DateTimePickerElement`, `'range'` → `DateRangePickerBase`/`DateRangePickerElement`. One shared config (mirroring how `SelectFieldConfig` is shared across select/autocomplete) carries every field; the panel and the exporter switch on `kind` to show/emit only the relevant ones: `weekStartsOn` is date+datetime only, `minuteStep` is datetime only, and `range` uses a fixed `displayFormat` enum. `min`/`max` are ISO strings (`''` = unset); the exporter maps them to `minDate`/`maxDate` (date, range) or `minDateTime`/`maxDateTime` (datetime). `dataType` is derived on export (date/datetime→`string`, range→`any`) so isn't edited here.

DesignSurfaces.description: Surface colours of one mode ('' = the library default for that mode).

DesignTheme.description: The mockup's design-only theme values (see the grilled design): per-mode surfaces and a font have no ThemeProvider equivalent, so they paint the canvas frame and the Live Preview wrapper, ship in project.json, and stay out of theme.ts.

DividerConfig.description: Editable config for a divider. Maps onto the library's `Divider` / engine `DividerElement`. `spacing` is the vertical margin in px (`''` = the component's 8px default).

DrawerConfig.description: Editable config for a drawer (MUI's temporary drawer). Maps onto the engine's `DrawerElement` minus the nested `container` (the item's child canvas). Like the modal, the trigger is a `ButtonConfig` (the engine takes any element; studio authors a button) and `id` is the engine registry key a `CloseModal` button inside it targets. `size` is any CSS length (`''` = the engine default: 360px for left / right, 50vh for top / bottom).

EditableTableEditor.description: Inline editor kinds for an editable-table column. Mirrors the library's `DataTableEditableEditor`.

EditableTableOption.description: One option for the `select` editor — fixed `{value, label}` shape (unlike the select field's open records), so it gets a structured row editor.

id.description: Stable id for React keys + store ops; never serialized.

name.description: Becomes the endpoint's key in the exported `TApiMaster` object.

url.description: Endpoint path; `:param` placeholders are filled from the parameter model.

withOptions.description: Only meaningful on GET — wraps the caller with `.use(options)`.

groupId.description: Shared-library group (`GroupDef.id`); null/absent = Ungrouped. Never serialized.

FieldKind.description: A field is a primitive, a nested object, or an array.

FilterDefaultRow.description: A filter's opening value (engine `filterDefaults`); `value` is text, parsed as JSON when it is a number / boolean / array.

addDisplay.description: What the Add button shows: icon + label, icon only, or label only.

removePosition.description: Where a row's Save / Remove controls sit relative to its fields.

readPaths.description: Dot path into the read response to the row array (`data`).

FormListConfig.description: Editable config for a form list. Maps onto the engine's `FormListElement`; the row template is the item's single child canvas (drill-in like a container). The three action toggles model `apiCrud.create/update/delete` presence — Add / Save / Remove exist only when their API is set — and the read call is always emitted (the engine throws loudly until it resolves). Empty labels fall back to the component's defaults at export.

FormListCrudRef.description: One CRUD call of a form list (see the grilled design). `endpointId` is the API page ref (`null` = unwired). `params` holds one source per `:param` of the endpoint URL (seeded on pick, pruned at export): a `row` source maps the param to a row field (engine `params`), any other source resolves from the route / state / a literal (engine `extraParams`, or `params` on the read call — `row` isn't offered there). `extra` is a free-form key → source map: the read call's `query`, a mutation's `extraBody`.

HiddenConfig.description: Editable config for a hidden field. Maps 1:1 onto the engine's `HiddenElement` (`name` + `dataType`) — it renders nothing at runtime, so the canvas always shows its chip and the only authoring is the binding.

HtmlContentConfig.description: Editable config for an HTML content block. Maps onto the engine `HtmlContentElement`: `html` is the `{{path}}` template, `binding` (inside a repeater's template) what the placeholders read — `key: 'none'` is the item itself — and `prose` the typographic defaults.

HttpMethod.description: Editor-side shapes for the API page. Endpoints reference models by their stable `ModelDef.id` — rename-safe, since a model rename on the Model page must not break endpoints — and `serialize.ts` resolves ids to current model names when lowering onto the engine's `TApiMaster` shape.

ItemBinding.description: A bound display value. `source` absent / `'row'`: `key` is a field of the enclosing repeater's item (`'none'` = the item itself). `'state'`: `key` is a page load's id (resolved to its key at export), `path` drills its data or reads `$status`.

MenuItemDef.description: One entry of the project's app-shell menu (see the grilled app-shell design) — the studio-side mirror of the library `MenuItem`, with a stable `id` for the sortable editor and an explicit `kind`. Page links store the page id and resolve to its key at export.

ModalConfig.description: Editable config for a modal. Maps onto the engine's `ModalElement` minus the nested `container` (the item's child canvas). The trigger is a full `ButtonConfig` (a modal's trigger is a `ButtonElement`); on export it gets `actions: ["OpenModal"]` wired for it. Sizing strings are any CSS length (`''` = unset).

id.description: Stable id for React keys + store tree ops; never serialized.

children.description: Nested fields — used when `kind === 'object'`, or `array` of object.

showSelectedCount.description: Show the `(n/max)` count label and chip-overflow summary.

optionsBinding.description: Options from a page load instead (`source: 'state'` — engine `optionsValue`): wins over both modes while set, which keep their config so switching back loses nothing. Rows are read with the same keys.

idKey.description: Which option-record key holds the stored value (Autocomplete2 `idKey`).

displayKey.description: The option's title — shown in the list and the trigger (`displayKey`).

searchKey.description: Which option-record key the type-ahead filters on (`searchKey`).

subtitleKey.description: Second line under the title (engine `itemSubtitle`); also matched by search.

avatarKey.description: Field holding an image URL or `{ src, alt, fallback }` (engine `itemAvatar`). Wins over `itemIcon` — a row has one leading visual.

inputIcon.description: `IconData` key shown in the trigger (engine `inputIcon`); `''` = the default search glyph.

itemIcon.description: `IconData` key shown on every option row (engine `itemIcon`).

dataSource.description: Runtime data source (`source` mode): the API page endpoint, referenced by `EndpointDef.id` (rename-safe like model refs; `null` = none picked) and resolved to the endpoint's current name at export. `paths` is the dot-path into the response to the option array (engine `api.paths`; `''` = the response is the array itself).

observeToItemId.description: `GridItemData.id` of another select-family item this one observes for a cascading refetch (engine `observeTo`); `''` = none. Stored by id so renaming the target's binding key can't break the link — `gridConfig` resolves it to the target's current name at export (see `observe.ts`). Only meaningful in `source` mode.

MultiAutocompleteConfig.description: Editable config for a multi-select autocomplete. A superset of `SelectFieldConfig` (it previews with the library's `MultiAutocompleteBase`, which shares the record-array option model) plus the two multi-only knobs the base component adds: `maxSelections` caps how many items can be chosen (`''` = unlimited, mirroring `width`/`maxLength`), and `showSelectedCount` toggles the `(n/max)` label + chip overflow. Both are exported on the `multiAutocomplete` element (`maxSelections` only when it is a number).

NavParamSource.description: Where one `:param` (or query key) of a navigation target gets its value — the studio-side mirror of the engine `DataValue` sources `NavigateTarget` accepts. `row` is only offered on a data table's row navigation.

loading.description: How the page waits (the engine `PageLoad.loading`): the overlay, skeletons on the bound components, or nothing.

PageLoadDef.description: A page-level data load (see the grilled page-data design): the engine `PageLoad` as the studio edits it. `id` is stable — bindings, conditions and other loads' `state` sources store it, and export resolves it to the current `key` (the global-state slice name), so the key can be renamed freely. `read` is the same endpoint + `:param` sources + query extras the repeater and form list use; `paths` is the dot path into the response.

PopoverConfig.description: Editable config for a popover. Maps onto the engine's `PopoverElement` minus the nested `container` (the item's child canvas). The trigger is a mini-Bin; studio restricts it to `button` | `text` (see the grilled design) and carries both configs so switching kinds is lossless. `offset` is the px gap (`''` = the component's 8px default).

Primitive.description: The five primitives `convertValue` accepts in the engine converter.

userId.description: Unique per profile (one person holds several).

nameTemplate.description: `{{path}}` template for the display name; `''` = the engine default (`{{firstNameEn}} {{lastNameEN}}`).

primary.description: The primary-assignment flag (`Y` / `true` / `1`): the profile picked when nobody chose one.

ProfileKeysConfig.description: Paths into one profile record — a fallback list per key, tried top to bottom (the engine `ProfileKeys`); an empty list keeps the engine default, which fits the default user-profile shape.

defaultValue.description: Preselected option value; `''` means nothing is selected.

RadioConfig.description: Editable config for a radio component. Unlike the checkbox there is no single/group fork — a radio is always a single-select group of `options`. Static-only for now (no API/source mode); the engine `RadioElement` supports API-driven options, but studio defers that. `defaultValue` preselects one option (`''` = none). Maps onto the library's `RadioButtonBase` / engine `RadioElement`; `dataType` is fixed to `string` on export (a radio stores one scalar value) and so isn't edited here.

RadioOption.description: A single radio option. Maps onto the library `RadioButtonProps` option shape (`value`/`label`/`disabled`) minus `helperText` — per-option sub-labels are out of studio's scope, matching the checkbox option editor.

stateBinding.description: The page load (array) the items come from (source `state`).

readPaths.description: Dot path into the read response to the item array (`data`).

parentField.description: Array field of the enclosing repeater's item (source `parent`).

gap.description: Tailwind spacing scale key (`'4'`) or a CSS length.

itemPadding.description: `''` = the component default (4 with a surface, else 0).

RepeaterConfig.description: Editable config for a repeater. Maps onto the engine's `RepeaterElement`; the item template is the item's single child canvas (drill-in like a container). The array comes from an endpoint (`read` — endpoint, `:param` sources, query extras — drilled by `readPaths`) or, inside another repeater's template, from an array field of the parent item (`parentField` → engine `items: { type:'row', key }`). `itemSpan` is out of 12 per studio breakpoint (exported like a bin: xs→sm, sm→md, md→lg, lg→lg+xl).

searchParam.description: The query key receiving the typed text; `''` = `search`.

canReplace.description: Who may replace, over the page's loads; null = everyone.

stateKey.description: The global-state slice holding the active profile; `''` = the engine default `profile`.

initial.description: The logged-in profile (a page load), seeding the slice while it is empty.

persist.description: Remember the choice (a switch in localStorage, a replacement in sessionStorage).

reload.description: Names registered for reload (tables, lists, page loads) refetched after the profile changes.

navigate.description: Where to go after the profile changes; null = stay.

ReplaceProfileConfig.description: Editable config for a Replace Profile trigger + dialog: people `search` (the typed text in `searchParam`), the picked person's profiles from `read`, who may replace (a page-data condition), the trigger button and the dialog's texts.

id.description: Studio-only stable row identity; never exported.

RequestMapRow.description: One row of a data table's request mapping → a key of engine `api.params` / `api.query` / `api.body`.

RequestSource.description: Where one request key of a data table's read call comes from: any  {@link  NavParamSource }  (literal / URL / global state — `row` has no meaning here), or a **filter field** of the table's filter form, with the fallback sent while that filter is blank (required when it feeds a URL `:param`).

optionsBinding.description: Options from a page load instead (`source: 'state'` — engine `optionsValue`): wins over both modes while set, which keep their config so switching back loses nothing. Rows are read with the same keys.

idKey.description: Which option-record key holds the stored value (Autocomplete2 `idKey`).

displayKey.description: The option's title — shown in the list and the trigger (`displayKey`).

searchKey.description: Which option-record key the type-ahead filters on (`searchKey`).

subtitleKey.description: Second line under the title (engine `itemSubtitle`); also matched by search.

avatarKey.description: Field holding an image URL or `{ src, alt, fallback }` (engine `itemAvatar`). Wins over `itemIcon` — a row has one leading visual.

inputIcon.description: `IconData` key shown in the trigger (engine `inputIcon`); `''` = the default search glyph.

itemIcon.description: `IconData` key shown on every option row (engine `itemIcon`).

dataSource.description: Runtime data source (`source` mode): the API page endpoint, referenced by `EndpointDef.id` (rename-safe like model refs; `null` = none picked) and resolved to the endpoint's current name at export. `paths` is the dot-path into the response to the option array (engine `api.paths`; `''` = the response is the array itself).

observeToItemId.description: `GridItemData.id` of another select-family item this one observes for a cascading refetch (engine `observeTo`); `''` = none. Stored by id so renaming the target's binding key can't break the link — `gridConfig` resolves it to the target's current name at export (see `observe.ts`). Only meaningful in `source` mode.

SelectFieldConfig.description: Editable config for a select component. The select previews with the library's `Autocomplete2`; `options`/`idKey`/`displayKey`/`searchKey` map onto its record-array option model. The presentational fields (`variant`, `size`, `radius`) and the textfield-parity fields (`dataType`, `isFullWidth`, `isFixedHeight`, `width`, `regex`, `regexErrorMessage`) are kept for a uniform panel + exported JSON — `Autocomplete2` ignores them. `mode` discriminates a hand-authored static `options` array from a `dataSource` the declarative engine resolves at runtime; both halves are always carried (and exported) regardless of the active mode.

SelectOption.description: A single static option for the select. The select's live preview renders the library's `Autocomplete2`, whose options are arbitrary records keyed by `idKey`/`displayKey`/`searchKey` (not a fixed `{ value, label }`), so an option is an open record. The author picks which keys carry the id/label via the config's `idKey`/`displayKey`/`searchKey`.

navigation.description: Where the menu renders: the collapsible sidebar or a strip in the top bar.

breadcrumbs.description: Show the breadcrumb strip under the top bar.

menuIcons.description: Show the icons of menu items (sidebar, drawer, top strip).

menuActiveColor.description: Text colour of the active sidebar / drawer item (any CSS colour) on its accent background; `''` / absent = the accent's contrast colour. Optional, so shells saved before it existed need no migration.

pageTransition.description: How a page enters on a route change (the engine `shell.pageTransition`, see the grilled design `page-transition`). Optional: absent = none, so older shells need no migration. `duration: ''` = the engine's 250 ms.

collapsible.description: Sidebar placement: offer the collapse-to-rail toggle.

sidebar.description: Sidebar look and collapse-toggle placement (workspace v53).

ShowWhen.description: When an item inside a data table's modal canvas is shown: always, only while adding (no row selected) or only while editing. Exported as the engine `condition` on `<table name>._id`; absent = always.

toggle.description: Collapse toggle in the top bar, or an icon + label row at the sidebar's foot.

toggleLabel.description: The footer toggle's label (empty = the library's "Hide Menu").

railWidth.description: CSS width of the icon rail (empty = 3.5rem plain / 4.5rem pill).

activeBackground.description: Active pill colour, used while the gradient is off (empty = the accent gradient).

activeGradient.description: Active pill gradient (wins while enabled, both stops needed).

indicator.description: The edge bar beside the active item; `null` = the variant's default (pill on, plain off).

SidebarSettings.description: The exported app's sidebar look (the library `SidebarConfig`, see the grilled design `sidebar-pill-variant`); empty strings mean unset.

StudioNavigate.description: A config-driven page change (see the grilled page-router design): the target page by stable id (resolved to its `key` at export — the engine `NavigateTarget.page`), one source per `:param` of the target's route, and whether to replace the history entry. Authored on a button (played by the `Navigate` action) or on a data table's row click.

StudioPageTransition.description: The studio side of the engine `PageTransition`.

surface.description: Flat panels or glass (workspace v54; `migrateV53` fills `flat`).

background.description: The glass backdrop (read only while `surface` is glass).

design.description: Design-only surfaces + font; absent on configs saved before it existed.

SwitchConfig.description: Editable config for a `switch` item — the engine `SwitchElement`: one boolean field drawn as an on / off toggle. `isRequired` means it must be on. `enabledWhen` names another switch on the same canvas (by item id, so a rename is safe); export turns it into the engine `enabledWhen` condition on this item and `canObserve: true` on the gating one.

SwitchEnabledWhen.description: Which value of the gating switch enables this one.

personParam.description: The URL `:param` the element fills with the active person's id; `''` = the endpoint's only one.

display.description: A list with the active row checked, or a dropdown (value = userId, label = job title).

showSubtitle.description: Show "company · department" after the job title.

stateKey.description: The global-state slice holding the active profile; `''` = the engine default `profile`.

initial.description: The logged-in profile (a page load), seeding the slice while it is empty.

persist.description: Remember the choice (a switch in localStorage, a replacement in sessionStorage).

reload.description: Names registered for reload (tables, lists, page loads) refetched after the profile changes.

navigate.description: Where to go after the profile changes; null = stay.

SwitchProfileConfig.description: Editable config for a Switch Profile list: the active person's profiles from `read` (drilled by `readPaths`; the person id fills `personParam`), the active one checked.

TabConfig.description: Editable config for a tab widget. The inspector manages the header list (add/remove — see the grilled design); each tab's content is authored by drilling into its child canvas. `defaultValue` picks the initially active tab (`''` = the first).

TabItemConfig.description: One tab header. The tab's content is the child canvas at the same index in the item's `childCanvases` (kept aligned by the store's tab actions).

binding.description: Inside a repeater: show this item field instead (`text` = fallback).

TextConfig.description: Editable config for a text component. Maps onto the library's `Text` / engine `TextElement`: `text` is the content and `isLabel` renders it as a form-label (block, small, medium-weight) instead of inline text. No binding `name` — TextElement carries none.

TextFieldConfig.description: Editable config for a textfield component. Maps 1:1 onto the library's `TextFieldElement` / `TextFieldProps` so the exported JSON can drive the declarative engine. `width` is `''` when unset (otherwise a pixel number).

TextareaConfig.description: Editable config for a textarea component. Maps onto the library's `TextareaElement` / `TextareaProps`. `dataType` is fixed to `'text'` (the base component ignores it) but kept so the exported `TextareaElement` stays contract-valid. `maxLength` is `''` when unset (mirrors `TextFieldConfig.width`).

ThemeAppearance.description: The Theme page's editable state — the app-wide ThemeProvider config a consumer keeps as `config/theme.ts` (see the grilled design). Color roles use `''` for "unset": unset dataTable roles follow the accent (dark-safe), an unset buttonColor omits the `button` override entirely, and unset keys are dropped from the export so the snippet stays minimal.

ThemeScaling.description: Radix `scaling` — the mockup's density: Compact / Cozy / Comfortable.

ThemeSurface.description: Surface style (the engine's `Surface`, see the grilled design `glass-surface`): solid panels, or translucent blurred glass over a backdrop.

binding.description: Inside a repeater: show this item field instead (`text` = fallback).

TypographyConfig.description: Editable config for a typography component — the curated slice of the engine's `TypographyElement` (see the grilled design): the props that visibly change a static preview (`variant`/`weight`/`color`/`align`/`truncate`) plus `href`. The rest (component/transform/decoration/noWrap/tooltip trio/rel/target) stays hand-editable in the exported JSON. `''` means "component default" for `weight`/`color`/`align` (Typography derives them from `variant`), and no link for `href`.

UploadAcceptPreset.description: Accept presets offered as chips. Mirrors the library's `AcceptPreset`.

UploadApiSettings.description: API-upload wiring, used only when `valueFormat` is `'api'`. Mirrors the library's `UploadApiConfig`: the file is POSTed to `uploadUrl`, optionally DELETEd from `deleteUrl` (carrying a `:filename` placeholder), sent under `fieldName`, and the stored URL is read from `responsePath` in the response. Always carried (so toggling `valueFormat` away from `'api'` and back is lossless) but only emitted in `'api'` mode.

UploadFileConfig.description: Editable config for a file upload. Maps onto the library's `UploadFileBase` / engine `UploadFileElement`. The engine `accept` is authored in two parts: `acceptPresets` (chips) plus `accept`, a comma list of extra raw types (e.g. `.dwg,.psd`) — see `uploadAccept`. `preview`/`previewLayout` drive the thumbnails + viewer. `multiple` enables multi-file selection with an optional `maxFiles` cap (`''` = unset). `valueFormat`/`api` behave as in the image upload. `dataType` is fixed to the engine's `any` on export (a file upload stores an array of files), so isn't edited here.

UploadImageConfig.description: Editable config for an image upload. Maps onto the library's `UploadImageBase` / engine `UploadImageElement`. `accept` defaults to `image/*`; `maxSizeMB` is `''` when unset (mirroring `width`/`maxLength`). `valueFormat` chooses how the value is stored, and when it is `'api'` the `api` wiring is emitted too. Unlike the input components, `UploadImageBase` has its own `isRequired` prop, so the marker isn't baked into the label. `dataType` is derived on export (bytes→`any`, else `string`) so isn't edited here.

UploadValueFormat.description: How an upload stores its value. Mirrors the library's `UploadValueFormat`.

WorkflowEditorConfig.description: Editable config for a workflow editor (see the grilled design). Maps onto the engine `WorkflowEditorElement`: the field (`name`, required ⇒ at least one step), the roles with their rules, the dialog's user source, the saved step field names (`stepKeys`, the engine defaults pre-filled) and the dialog labels (exported only when changed).

WorkflowRoleConfig.description: One role of a workflow editor (engine `WorkflowRole`; `max` / `position` as studio "unset" idioms).

WorkflowUsersConfig.description: The dialog's user list: an endpoint walked along `paths` to the user rows, read with these keys.
